[[File:Tridyakis icosahedron.stl|thumb|3D model of a tridyakis icosahedron]]
In [[geometry]], the '''tridyakis icosahedron''' is the [[dual polyhedron]] of the [[nonconvex uniform polyhedron]], [[icositruncated dodecadodecahedron]]. It has 44 vertices, 180 edges, and 120 scalene triangular faces.

== Proportions ==
The triangles have one angle of <math>\arccos(\frac{3}{5})\approx 53.130\,102\,354\,16^{\circ}</math>, one of <math>\arccos(\frac{1}{3}+\frac{4}{15}\sqrt{5})\approx 21.624\,633\,927\,143^{\circ}</math> and one of <math>\arccos(\frac{1}{3}-\frac{4}{15}\sqrt{5})\approx 105.245\,263\,718\,70^{\circ}</math>. The [[dihedral angle]] equals <math>\arccos(-\frac{7}{8})\approx 151.044\,975\,628\,14^{\circ}</math>. Part of each triangle lies within the solid, hence is invisible in solid models.
